title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Agents usage report
summary: The report description, licensing distinction and both governance controls remain supported, including by the changed Agent 365 service description. Minor corrections should acknowledge conflicting GCC documentation, complete the report navigation and address the role-assignment decision missing from the controls table.
